description: Give the user the Dozo PDF tool they need, on dozokit.com: merge (several PDFs into one), compress (make a PDF smaller), compress_200kb and compress_100kb (when the user has a 200 KB or 100 KB upload limit: the page keeps compressing until the file fits), split (by page ranges), jpg_to_pdf (images into one PDF), sign, organize (reorder, rotate, delete pages). The user picks the files there and they never leave their device. Files already attached to this conversation cannot be used. Read-only. Donne le lien vers l’outil PDF : les fichiers restent sur l’appareil.

lang.description: Language of the tool, fr for a French-speaking user.

name: pdf_tool
title: Open a PDF tool
